chapters.title: Phi Chi Theta — Find A Chapter
chapters.method: All 50 collegiate listings transcribed from the national directory; 6 explicit alumni listings excluded. Chapter URLs extracted from that page; null means the national listing did not link the chapter. Standard university names normalized; corrections documented per record.

coordinates.publisher: U.S. Department of Education, National Center for Education Statistics
coordinates.dataset: IPEDS Institutional Characteristics, Directory information, HD2024
coordinates.method: Exact campus-level UNITID matches; use federal published latitude/longitude without geocoding or manual coordinate estimates. University/campus correspondence and state checked for each record.
coordinates.precision: Institution locations are approximate main-campus points and do not identify chapter meeting rooms or private residences.
coordinates.license: U.S. federal statistical data; public-domain factual coordinates.

states.upstreamDescription: us-atlas 3.0.1 redistribution of U.S. Census Bureau 2017 cartographic state boundaries at 1:10 million resolution.
states.method: Decoded original quantized delta arcs to WGS84 longitude/latitude GeoJSON; coordinates rounded to 5 decimal places; retained 48 contiguous states plus the District of Columbia; excluded Alaska, Hawaii, and territories. No additional simplification. One zero-area Delaware island component collapsed to two distinct points in the upstream quantized topology and was omitted to keep GeoJSON rings valid.
states.license: Census boundaries are U.S. government public data; us-atlas distribution carries ISC license retained alongside the derivative.

normalizations.sourceIssue: National directory names “University of Washington, St. Louis, MO.”
normalizations.resolution: Washington University in St. Louis; the national chapter social handle pctwashu and official Olin undergraduate organization list confirm Phi Chi Theta.
Normalized to Zeta Pi per the official chapter website.
